judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A pleasant, well-structured sky with elegant cirrus wisps and layered bands, but the flat midday light keeps it from being truly striking.
strengths: delicate wispy cirrus streaks add texture
layered cloud bands give depth and separation
weaknesses: flat, even daylight with no warm or dramatic light
no foreground or context, just a sky patch
lower cloud bands are somewhat featureless and gray
